title: [程序员] DeepSeek Harness 来了，一切皆插件的 Agent 框架
raw_text:
DeepSeek Harness 技术拆解，一切皆插件的 Agent 框架

DeepSeek Harness 的开发者预览版上线了，代码已经开源，仓库在 github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness 。圈内习惯叫它 dsh 。

它是 DeepSeek 做的开源 Agent 框架，和 Claude Code 是一类东西，跑在本地，让模型替你真干活。上线前它内测了一阵，这篇按技术脉络把最要紧的设计讲清楚，想快速了解它，看这篇就够。

它是什么

dsh 是一个装在你机器上的编程智能体。装了 Node 开发环境，一行命令 npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web 就能把 Web UI 拉起来，浏览器打开（默认 127.0.0.1:3080 ）就能对话、审批、切换模式。

模型在里面做的事比陪聊多得多，改文件、跑命令、查资料，最后把活干完。最值得看的是它的设计方式。

一切皆插件

这个框架的第一设计原则是 everything is a plugin ，一切皆插件。

多数软件把核心逻辑写死，用户只能在预留的少数接口上做有限定制。dsh 反过来，模型接入、工具注册表、会话日志、审批策略，连驱动智能体运转的主循环本身，全部都是插件。

想换搜索引擎、接自己公司的模型服务，改配置就行，不用动框架代码。给系统加功能就是挂一个新插件，卸载时注册的一切自动撤销，不留残余。

技术上它站在 Cordis 之上，这是 Koishi 生态一直在用的插件与上下文内核，只负责插件的加载、卸载和依赖关系。dsh 的所有具体组件都是不同插件，靠服务与事件协作，在配置层自由组合。开发者不改 dsh 源码，就能独立选择、替换、扩展任意一项能力。

分层组装与能力接缝

运行中的 dsh 是一棵插件树，由多层配置按固定顺序叠加。组合包 bundle 是官方发布的成套插件配置，Profile 是你机器上的具名组装清单，P
reason_zh: DeepSeek Harness开源Agent框架深度拆解，揭示设计理念，对开发者极具参考价值。

title: Making Your LLMs More Objective: Stabilizing LLM Safety Behavior Across Traits with Trait-Invariant Safety Tuning
raw_text:
arXiv:2608.11705v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Aligned large language models (LLMs) are expected to exhibit safety behavior based on the content of the user request: they should refuse unsafe requests and comply with safe ones. However, we show that the same request can elicit substantially different safety decisions under different traits assigned in the system prompt, a failure mode we call trait-induced safety variation. To measure this failure, we introduce refusal-based metrics: Trait-Induced Deviation measures dataset-level deviation from the no-trait baseline, while Trait-Induced Flip Rate measures whether the same request receives different safety decisions across traits. We then provide a representation-level analysis of the mechanism behind trait-induced safety shifts and find that traits perturb the model's safety representations within a low-dimensional subspace. To achieve trait-invariant safety, where safety behavior remains stable across traits, we introduce Trait-Inva
reason_zh: 揭示LLM安全行为随系统提示特质变化的不稳定性，提出特质不变安全微调，提升安全性。
summary_zh: 对齐的LLM应根据用户请求的内容表现出安全行为：拒绝不安全请求，遵守安全请求。然而，本文表明，在系统提示中分配不同特质时，同一请求可能引发截然不同的安全决策，这种失败模式称为特质敏感性。本文提出特质不变安全微调（Trait-Invariant Safety Tuning），旨在稳定LLM在不同特质下的安全行为，减少因提示变化导致的安全漏洞。
title_zh: 让LLM更客观：通过特质不变安全微调稳定跨特质的安全行为

title: The Off-Support Barrier: Why Semantic Safety Constraints Are Not Learning-Problem Invariants, and What Follows for Prior Design, Containment, and Verification
raw_text:
arXiv:2608.11243v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: We argue that a single structural fact organizes a wide range of phenomena in contemporary AI safety: a semantic safety constraint (e.g., the agent does not escape its sandbox) is an off-support object. Formally, if q is the data distribution and \(p(\cdot\mid w)\) the model, the safety predicate B is not measurable with respect to \(\sigma(\text{model}, q)\), whereas the real log-canonical threshold (RLCT) of singular learning theory (SLT) is. From this non-invariance we derive, as corollaries rather than independent observations: (i) why reward hacking and sandbox escape arise under outcome-based optimization; (ii) why encoding such constraints through Bayesian prior design or soft penalty weighting has poor leverage in singular models; (iii) why hard invariants belong in the harness and soft dispositions in the model; (iv) why the same B is nonetheless soundly and locally certifiable by formal verification, exactly as the local learni
reason_zh: 提出语义安全约束是离支持对象的观点，从结构上解释安全失败，对 AI 安全研究有深刻启发。
summary_zh: 本文认为一个结构事实组织了当代 AI 安全的广泛现象：语义安全约束（例如智能体不逃出沙箱）是离支持对象。形式上，如果 q 是数据分布，p(·|w) 是模型，则安全谓词 B 相对于 σ(模型) 不可测。这一观点解释了为什么安全约束难以通过训练数据学习，并提出了对先验设计、包含和验证的启示。文章为 AI 安全提供了新的理论视角。
title_zh: 离支持障碍：为什么语义安全约束不是学习问题的不变量，以及对先验设计、包含和验证的启示

title: FrontierFinance: A Challenging Benchmark for Measuring Frontier Intelligence of Finance Agents
raw_text:
arXiv:2608.11683v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: AI agents are increasingly deployed for professional investment research, yet no benchmark captures the complexity of the full investor workflow. Existing benchmarks mainly target financial data extraction, a narrow slice that current models have largely saturated, while reference-based metrics and generic LLM-as-a-judge scoring fall short on the open-ended, long-form answers that real analyst queries demand. We introduce FrontierFinance, a fully open benchmark of 220 expert-crafted queries and 11,543 source-attributed rubrics spanning six crucial use cases across the full investor workflow. FrontierFinance is both broader and harder than existing public finance benchmarks. Evaluating frontier models and agent systems under a common harness restricted to publicly available data, we find that the tool harness, not the model alone, strongly shapes quality and efficiency; that Samaya's in-house system leads at 56.0%, ahead of the strongest
reason_zh: 首个覆盖完整投资者工作流的金融智能体基准，挑战前沿智能，填补评估空白。
summary_zh: AI智能体越来越多地用于专业投资研究，但现有基准无法捕捉完整投资者工作流的复杂性。现有基准主要针对金融数据提取，这一狭窄领域已被当前模型基本饱和，而基于参考的指标和通用LLM评判评分在开放式任务上表现不足。本文提出FrontierFinance，一个具有挑战性的基准，用于衡量金融智能体的前沿智能，覆盖从数据收集到投资决策的完整流程。
title_zh: FrontierFinance：衡量金融智能体前沿智能的挑战性基准

title: FP8 Training on AMD GPUs with TorchTitan and TorchAO: Upstreaming Performance Improvements
raw_text: At the PyTorch Conference 2025, we demonstrated linear scaling beyond 1,000 GPUs on AMD Instinct clusters using Primus-Turbo, an AMD optimization library for training frameworks such as TorchTitan. We have since upstreamed those AMD optimizations so TorchTitan supports AMD Instinct(™) GPUs directly, with competitive FP8 performance out of the box. All contributions mentioned have been merged into upstream pytorch/AO and pytorch/TorchTitan.

title: RecSys Factory: Bounding LLM Agent Autonomy to Decision Points in the Industrial Recommender Lifecycle
raw_text:
arXiv:2608.11241v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Deploying LLM agents into industrial recommender operations exposes a three-way tension we frame as the autonomy-determinism-efficiency trilemma: general autonomy (interpreting operator intent, generating glue code zero-shot), industrial determinism (schema-conforming feature extraction, non-crashing A/B, zero compliance-path hallucination), and end-to-end efficiency. Any two can be maximized against the third. We present RecSys Factory, an LLM-agent platform deployed for 78 days across three heterogeneous Tencent recommender business lines. The design principle is autonomy at decision points, not over pipelines, made concrete through three deconstructions that each discharge one vertex of the trilemma. Runtime is deconstructed into three host-emitted event sources (Claude Code Stop hooks, corporate-IM webhooks, workflow scheduler APIs): the platform carries no long-running daemon during the wait phase and consumes zero CPU during the 94
reason_zh: 提出将 LLM 智能体自主性限制在决策点的方法，解决工业推荐系统中的自主性-确定性-效率三难问题，工程实践价值高。
summary_zh: 将 LLM 智能体部署到工业推荐运营中，面临自主性-确定性-效率的三难问题：通用自主性（解释操作员意图、零样本生成胶水代码）、工业确定性（符合模式的特征提取、无崩溃 A/B 测试、零合规路径幻觉）和端到端效率。本文提出 RecSys Factory，通过将智能体自主性限制在决策点，平衡三者。该方法在真实工业场景中验证了有效性，为 LLM 智能体的工业落地提供了新思路。
title_zh: RecSys Factory：将 LLM 智能体自主性限制在工业推荐生命周期的决策点

title: Deployment Decision Reliability: A Generalizability-Theory Framework for Sizing Long-Horizon Agent Evaluations
raw_text:
arXiv:2608.11323v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Enterprise practitioners read agent leaderboards as if they ranked agent capability. We show, across three open agent-trace benchmarks (TheAgentCompany, $\tau^2$-bench, and AppWorld), that the agent main effect accounts for less than 3% of total variance in every dataset and check type, while the agent-by-task interaction accounts for 7-23%. Leaderboards rank specialization, not capability. We arrive at this through a four-facet Generalizability Theory variance decomposition, fit with three estimators (Henderson Method-I, REML via lme4, and a Bayesian binomial GLMM) that agree to three decimal places. Four further findings sharpen what the leaderboard is hiding. First, aggregate reliability collapses on the hardest task quartile: $E\rho^2$ on $\tau^2$ action_checks falls from 0.752 to 0.000. Second, training-cell reliability negatively correlates with held-out reliability ($r = -0.90$ on $\tau^2$), meaning the designs that look most reli
reason_zh: 用概化理论揭示智能体排行榜的误导性，对评估实践有重要警示作用。
summary_zh: 本文使用概化理论框架分析长期智能体评估的可靠性。在三个开放基准（TheAgentCompany、τ²-bench、AppWorld）上，作者发现智能体主效应仅占总方差不到3%，而智能体-任务交互占7-23%。这意味着排行榜排名可能主要反映任务选择而非智能体能力，对部署决策具有误导性。作者提出更可靠的评估方法，为智能体评估设计提供了新视角。
title_zh: 部署决策可靠性：用于长期智能体评估规模的概化理论框架

title: Foresight Without Seeing: Latent Futures for World Action Models
raw_text:
arXiv:2608.11605v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: World Action Models (WAMs) couple future visual prediction with robot action generation, enabling policies to model how the physical world evolves during interaction. Existing WAMs differ in how predictive dynamics are exposed to the action pathway. Explicit-future WAMs provide direct access to predicted scene evolution, but incur substantial inference costs from iterative video denoising. In contrast, direct-policy WAMs efficiently predict actions from the current observation but lack an explicit inference-time interface for exposing predictive dynamics to the Action DiT. To bridge this gap, we propose ForeWAM, a dynamics-conditioned direct-policy WAM that provides predictive context for action generation without decoding future videos. At its core, Future-KV performs a single Video DiT prefill over the current visual latent and stochastic future slots, and reuses the resulting layer-wise key-value states throughout action denoising. We
reason_zh: 提出世界动作模型的潜在未来表示，平衡预测与推理效率，对机器人学习有启发。
summary_zh: 世界动作模型（WAMs）将未来视觉预测与机器人动作生成相结合，使策略能够建模物理世界在交互中的演化。现有WAMs在预测动态如何暴露给动作路径上有所不同：显式未来WAMs提供对预测场景演化的直接访问，但推理开销大；隐式方法则可能损失信息。本文提出一种潜在未来表示方法，在不直接生成完整未来帧的情况下，为动作生成提供有效信息，兼顾性能与效率。
title_zh: 未见之预见：世界动作模型的潜在未来

title: XBridge: Entity-Grounded Latent Bridge for Heterogeneous LLM Communication
raw_text:
arXiv:2608.11676v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Heterogeneous multi-agent LLM systems, where agents are powered by different model families, can outperform homogeneous configurations by reducing redundant reasoning patterns. Yet existing communication protocols either operate through text, discarding the sender's internal representations, or require architectural homogeneity for latent-level transfer. We identify the entity grounding problem in cross-architecture communication: cross-attention bridges that transfer continuous representations across different LLM families suffer from rare-token compression collapse, where entity identity is lost in the continuous bottleneck (bridge-only F1 ~30%). We propose XBRIDGE, a decode-free communication protocol that addresses this through two mechanisms. title: 部分 Claude 模型将添加“文本水印”，Anthropic 回应各界关切
raw_text:
IT之家 8 月 13 日消息，Anthropic 本周宣布，部分 Claude 模型会直接在输出文本中嵌入一种“难以察觉的水印”。内容被复制粘贴后，水印仍会随文本保留，经过一定程度修改后也可能继续存在，用于帮助判断一段文字究竟由 AI 生成还是由人类撰写。

Anthropic 目前尚未公开水印系统的完整技术原理。技术细节的不透明已经引发一些科技从业者担忧。具体来看，版权如何认定、Claude 输出质量是否会受到影响，以及只使用 AI 进行少量辅助的作品会不会因此被误判等问题，备受关注。

据《商业内幕》今天（12 日）晚间报道，Anthropic 方面对于各界关心的问题作出了回应。

谁能识别水印？

科技投资人比尔 · 格利担心，如果只有 Anthropic 能够识别水印，Anthropic 就可能同时扮演“法官、陪审团和检察官”的多重角色。

Anthropic 发言人回应说，公司计划提供免费的应用程序接口（API），让普通用户和第三方也能自行检测一段文字是否带有 Claude 水印。

只让 AI 稍作修改的内容怎么算？

一些开发者还担心，如果 Anthropic 通过特定词语组合来标记 AI 生成文本，水印机制可能会影响 Claude 本身的回答。Anthropic 发言人称，水印不会改变 Claude 回答的含义、质量或可读性。

数字医疗机构 Klick 生成式 AI 负责人西蒙 · 史密斯周二在 X 发文称，他担心仅由 AI 做过轻微处理的文字也会被认定为 AI 创作，例如只是把一篇文章交给 Claude 检查语法。

Anthropic 表示，水印代表的是 Claude 曾经处理过文本，并不能证明整段文字都是 Claude 写的。即使 Claude 只负责校对、翻译或总结，水印也可能继续保留。

对版权会有何种影响？

微软前高管史蒂文 · 辛诺夫斯基把关注点放在了数字隐私上。“真正的问题是数据保留，以及你是否有权拥有不留下数字痕迹的私人想法。”
reason_zh: Anthropic为Claude添加文本水印，回应版权、质量等关切，涉及AI伦理与监管，值得关注。
summary_zh: Anthropic宣布将在部分Claude模型输出中嵌入难以察觉的文本水印，用于判断内容是否由AI生成。水印在复制粘贴后仍会保留，且经过一定修改也可能存在。Anthropic尚未公开完整技术原理，引发科技从业者对版权认定、输出质量影响及误判风险的担忧。Anthropic对各界关切作出了回应，但具体细节未完全披露。

title: LinearKV: One Cached State Suffices for Position-Independent Caching in Hybrid LLMs
raw_text:
arXiv:2608.11231v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: LLM serving is increasingly accelerated by position-independent caching (PIC). Existing PIC methods, however, are built for full-attention models, where a token-indexed KV cache underlies its core operations: matching reusable token chunks, concatenating their KV entries, and selectively recomputing a few tokens to restore cross-chunk context. Hybrid LLMs break these primitives---they replace most attention layers with linear recurrences that expose only a fixed-size state, leaving no token-indexed KV to concatenate or to locally repair. This raises a natural question: can PIC benefit hybrid models, and what would it take? We present LinearKV, a training-free hybrid-PIC framework. Its key insight is a \emph{decoupled initialization}: each linear layer maps its $K$ matched local states to a single initial state, while full-attention layers concatenate their KV as before. LinearKV is therefore compatible with existing PIC methods, reusing
reason_zh: 提出LinearKV，为混合LLM实现位置无关缓存，显著提升推理效率，实用价值高。
summary_zh: LLM服务越来越依赖位置无关缓存（PIC）加速。现有PIC方法针对全注意力模型设计，其核心操作基于令牌索引的KV缓存：匹配可重用令牌块、拼接其KV条目、选择性重算少数令牌以恢复跨块上下文。混合模型架构不同，现有方法不适用。本文提出LinearKV，仅需一个缓存状态即可实现混合LLM的位置无关缓存，大幅降低缓存开销，提升推理速度。

title: invoke-ai/InvokeAI v6.13.8
raw_text:
# InvokeAI Version 6.13.8

## ⚠️ This is a security patch release

Recent versions of InvokeAI through 6.13.7 contain two security holes:

1. An attacker can craft a URL payload that overwrites files in the server's custom nodes directory, allowing for execution of arbitrary code on the next startup. On Windows systems, the hole could allow an arbitrary file to be placed anywhere on the filesystem that the server has access to.
2. A second bugs allows the server to be tricked into connecting to arbitrary networks and services on the local LAN or the Internet.

Both scenarios are closed by this release, and InvokeAI users are strongly encouraged to upgrade.

Many thanks to Abhinash Singh and Arpit Jain for independently reporting issue #1.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/invoke-ai/InvokeAI/compare/v6.13.7...v6.13.8

title: Liquid AI Releases LFM2.5-VL-3B: A 3B Vision-Language Model That Reads Screens, Grounds Objects, and Calls Tools On-Device
raw_text:
Liquid AI released LFM2.5-VL-3B, a 3.1B-parameter vision-language model built for on-device deployment. It averages 80.7 on ScreenSpot-v2 and lifts RefCOCO grounding from 57.1 to 87.9. Function calling is new to the VL line, with ToolSandbox moving from 26.4 to 59.5. The model fits in roughly 3 GB and decodes 228 tokens/s on an Apple M5 Max.

title: [开源软件] 实测对比： DeepSeek Harness (dsh) vs BitFun，两个开源 Agent Harness 的不同解法
raw_text:
DeepSeek 今天把 Harness （ dsh ）开了开发者预览、MIT 协议。我两个都装了本机跑了一遍——dsh 和我一直在做的 BitFun——写个客观对比给选型的朋友。

## 定位
- **dsh**：DeepSeek 官方 agent harness ，Node/TS ，跑在 Cordis 元框架上，核心是「 everything is a plugin 」；形态 web / headless / tui 三种 profile 。
- **BitFun**：Rust + Tauri 桌面 agent ，模型无关，走「桌面 + 任务专属 Mini App 」路线。

## 架构
dsh 的 profile 是插件 bundle 的 patch 层按序叠加，换 provider 就是往 ctx.llm 注册个适配器（内置 llm-deepseek 、llm-pi-ai ）。
BitFun 是四层定制：自定义 Agent → MCP / Skills / Codex 兼容 Hooks → Mini Apps → 源码级；模型开箱即多，catalog 里有 Claude / DeepSeek / GLM / Kimi / Qwen 。

## 上下文成本（我最在意的）
dsh 用 compaction （ basic + tool-result-pruner ）+ token-meter 压上下文。
BitFun 走另一条路：prompt 拼接字节级稳定，跨轮不带会抖动的时间戳、不重排，SWE-Bench-Pro 实测 KV cache 平均命中率 98.67%；检索用常驻跨轮索引 flashgrep ，Chromium 级仓库最高省 94.6%、平均约 36 倍。

## 权限
都有审批：dsh 的 tool-ask-user ，BitFun 的权限审批 + 远程审批； BitFun 额外有零知识中继的自托管多设备控制。

## 结论
不是谁更好，是默认取舍不同。要 DeepSeek 官方生态 + 插件可组合性跟 dsh （注意还是 dev preview ，会有 breakin
reason_zh: 作者实测对比两个开源Agent Harness，从架构、定位等维度分析，对选型有实际参考价值。
summary_zh: 本文对比了DeepSeek Harness（dsh）和BitFun两个开源Agent Harness。dsh是DeepSeek官方产品，基于Node/TS和Cordis框架，核心是“一切皆插件”，支持web/headless/tui三种profile；BitFun是Rust+Tauri桌面Agent，模型无关，走“桌面+任务专属Mini App”路线。作者从定位、架构等方面进行了客观对比，并分享了实际使用体验，为开发者选型提供了参考。
